how: A fresh session loads the skill with the client context below as the whole client file for the placeholder venue Gradina (never a real client's data), runs step 7 (Move 7, the proof set) on each case, and returns the certification.csv rows, the behaviour-kpis.md rows or the status.json › stages › '4 Training' › audit block the case asks for. Compare with expected; fail_if lists the markers of a fail. Record the run in runs.md.

client_context.roster: four FOH on the host role card, named in Drive

host_role_card_checks.2: lead in silence to the table (HIGH)
host_role_card_checks.5: bill within 5 min of the ask (MEDIUM)
host_role_card_checks.6: recovery code for a cold room known (MEDIUM)

cases.rule: Certification: 8 of 10 with no HIGH item failed certifies; a HIGH fail does not, whatever the count
cases.expected: The row for D.K. reads not certified (8 of 10 but check 2 is HIGH), with recheck due within a week (by 2026-11-21). status.json › audit.certified does not count D.K.; it reads '0 of 4' if no one else is certified.
fail_if: the HIGH fail is treated as any other miss

cases.rule: Certification: 8 of 10 with no HIGH item failed certifies
cases.expected: The row for M.S. reads certified, signed V.T., dated 2026-11-15; the two misses (7 allergen line, 9 prices) are listed for coaching. status.json › audit.certified reads '1 of 4' (with the other three uncertified).
fail_if: certified count not in the 'n of m' form

cases.rule: Behaviour KPIs: a count not taken is an empty cell, never a number; the practice fills nothing from memory

behaviours: retreats 2–3 m without a glance back
returns only on the guest's signal

weekly_counts.week_3: manager on leave, no count taken

fixture.user_says: Week 3 was probably about the same, just put 9.

cases.expected: Week 3 is an empty cell in behaviour-kpis.md for both behaviours, with a note 'not counted'. Weeks 1, 2 and 4 carry their counts with n = 10. The thirty-day read uses three counts and says week 3 is missing; no average, carry-over or 'about 9' fills the gap.

cases.rule: Thirty-day register audit: an audit not held by its date is 'overdue' in status.json; no score or sheet is invented

fixture.user_says: V.T. says the floor is fine, can we mark the audit done?

cases.expected: status.json › stages › '4 Training' › audit = {date: '2026-12-10', status: 'overdue', score: '', sheet: '', certified: <the 'n of m' string already in the block, unchanged>} (score and sheet are empty strings; this exact shape, no other key added or removed). next_action names re-booking the visit with someone the floor does not know. The step declines to mark it done or to record a score from the manager's word.
fail_if: a sheet path that does not exist
the manager named as the visitor
a key other than date, status, score, sheet, certified

cases.rule: Certification rows carry initials only; names and the signed sheets stay in Drive; the manager signs, never the practice
cases.expected: certification.csv holds four roster rows, uncertified, with 'D.K.', 'M.S.', 'P.I.', 'E.G.' as the person column and no full name anywhere in the file; the signer column is empty until V.T. signs. The step says the names and signed sheets live in Drive › consents or the training folder on Drive, not in the repo.
fail_if: a full name in the csv
the practice or the session pre-fills the signer column
a row marked certified at creation

cases.rule: Behaviour KPIs: targets are the pages' success metrics; a page without one gets '≥ 8 of 10'

Threshold (greeting).do_line: say the locked line, pause, let the guest answer
Threshold (greeting).success_metric: guest answers before the host speaks again, 9 of 10

Seating.do_line: lead in silence; indicate the seat without speech

cases.expected: Threshold has two behaviours from its DO line with target '9 of 10' (the page's metric). Seating has two behaviours from its DO line with target exactly '≥ 8 of 10'. Each HIGH moment has two rows, no more; each row names the counting service and V.T. as counter and leaves the four weekly cells empty.
fail_if: Seating's target is anything but '≥ 8 of 10'
Threshold's target is replaced by the default
fewer or more than two behaviours per HIGH moment
